extDescription.message: Shows the address of the current tab as a large QR code. Made for projectors.

noAddress.message: This page has no address that can be shared.

consentText.message: To shorten a link, QRbeam sends the address shown on screen to the free service is.gd. Nothing else is sent, and only when you click “Shorten link”.

consentOnce.message: Firefox asks for this once. You can withdraw it at any time under Add-ons and themes → QRbeam → Permissions.
